name: runtime_account_lthash
description: One row each time replay computes an account's final-value LtHash contribution for a block. Speculative hashes can be recomputed within a block; the row with the highest lthash_seq per (bank_seq, pubkey) is the one that went into the bank hash.

bank_seq.description: Bank sequence number, counting from 1 within a run; the join key to runtime_block for slot and block_id. Not meaningful across restarts: scope by the stream's instance id from the connection's authentication metadata.

slot.description: Slot whose LtHash this account contributes to

lthash_seq.description: Order in which this hash was computed within the block, from a per-bank counter. A recomputed hash always has a higher value than the one it replaces, so the highest lthash_seq per (bank_seq, pubkey) is the final hash.

lthash_32.description: First 32 bytes of the account's 2048-byte LtHash value. LtHash is blake3 in extended-output mode, so this equals the account's ordinary 32-byte blake3 hash of (lamports, data, executable, owner, pubkey) and identifies its exact contents. All-zero if the account has zero lamports (deleted).
